rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Sentrik is a governance runtime that scans AI-generated code against regulatory frameworks including OWASP Top 10, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and FDA IEC 62304. It gates pull requests that fail compliance checks and generates cryptographically signed audit evidence. The MCP server gives AI coding agents real-time access to compliance rules, scan results, and remediation guidance during code generation. It integrates with Claude Code, Cursor, and VS Code via the stdio transport.
